announcements.title: Introducing the Kashshāf Beta!
announcements.body:
I'm excited to share this resource, and I look forward to working with you and others to make it as useful as possible for researchers of the Arabic textual tradition.

Kashshaf provides linguistically precise search across a corpus of medieval Arabic texts (≤1348/1930 AH/CE), with features including:

• **Lemma and Root search** - Find all morphological variants of a word
• **Proximity search** - Locate terms appearing near each other
• **Name search** - Search for Arabic personal names with pattern generation
• **Token overlay** - Click any word to see its morphological analysis

This is an ongoing project. If you encounter issues or have suggestions, please reach out via [GitHub](https://github.com/ammusto/kashshaf) or the feedback form.

Thank you for being an early user!
